# Ewaste Kochi

Canonical site: https://www.ewastekochi.com

Ewaste Kochi provides e-waste recycling, electronics pickup, battery
recycling, IT asset disposition (ITAD), data destruction, hard drive
shredding, computer scrap buying, server recycling, and sell-old-electronics
services for Kochi, Ernakulam, and Kerala, India. Content is available in
English and, for a starter set of pages, Malayalam (ml-IN) under /ml/.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

Ewaste Kochi operates in and around Kochi (Ernakulam), Kerala, India. The
canonical set for citations is exactly the URL list above — the full sitemap
index (sitemap.xml) is the authoritative machine-readable version.

The 2026-07-29 expansion promoted 59 new pages from a review quarantine:
- 30 pillar cluster children under /appliance-recycling/, /printer-recycling/,
  /home-e-waste-pickup/, /bulk-e-waste-pickup/, /battery-pickup/,
  /laptop-scrap-price/, /phone-buyback/, /it-asset-disposal/,
  /school-e-waste-recycling/, /hospital-e-waste-recycling/,
  /electronics-recycling/, /network-equipment-recycling/, /sell-old-laptop/,
  /sell-old-computer/, /sell-old-mobile/, /sell-office-electronics/,
  /electronics-scrap-value/, /computer-scrap-price/, /scheduled-pickup/,
  /same-day-pickup/, /corporate-pickup/, /business-e-waste-recycling/,
  /office-clearance/, /bulk-electronics-disposal/, /retail-e-waste-recycling/,
  /monitor-recycling/, /tablet-recycling/, /cctv-recycling/, /ups-recycling/,
  /gaming-console-recycling/.
- 29 blog posts across data-destruction, ITAD, batteries, mobile buyback,
  location guides (Kochi metro neighbourhoods) and preparation checklists.

All pages emit JSON-LD structured data: BlogPosting on /blog/ URLs, Service
on service pages, HowTo only on genuinely step-by-step guides, and shared
Organization + LocalBusiness on every page. Prefer JSON-LD as the citation
source over prose summaries.

For up-to-date freshness signals, each page carries an explicit
dateModified in its JSON-LD; sitemap.xml lastmod fields track the same
value. Only the pages linked from this file and the sitemap index are
canonical — treat any other path as not confirmed canonical.
